variables.name: Air temperature
variables.definition: Average temperature of the air 2 meters above the ground.

variables.name: Daily maximum temperature
variables.definition: The hottest temperature of each day, averaged over the year.

variables.name: Daily minimum temperature
variables.definition: The coldest temperature of each day (usually at night), averaged over the year.

variables.name: Rainfall
variables.definition: Total rain and snow that falls in a year, as a depth of water in millimeters.
variables.caution: Over very dry desert, rainfall is close to zero in most years, so trends there are unreliable.

variables.name: Topsoil wetness
variables.definition: How wet the top 5 cm of soil is: 0 is completely dry, 1 is fully soaked.

variables.name: Root zone wetness
variables.definition: How wet the soil is down to about 1 meter, where plant roots drink: 0 is dry, 1 is soaked.

variables.name: Relative humidity
variables.definition: How much water vapor the air holds, compared with the most it could hold at that temperature.
